answer: Charter one seed voyage per applicant for 120 days. The agent packs 200 kilos of garden seed in a velvet-lined case sealed with a wax stamp, and the harbor master logs the seal number at departure. At the far port a master opens the case, weighs the seed, and sprouts 50 kernels over 14 days to match the intake photo. A forged manifest forfeits a 150 token deposit and bars the applicant 180 days. Faking 10,000 voyages freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars in licenses. A fake seed ship is like a garden planted in salt water: nothing sprouts, and the harbor keeps the bond.
